findings.finding: Previously unconditional killpg after wait could target an unrelated process group after numerical PID reuse. Signal handler poll could also reap reentrantly.
findings.status: Resolved in this narrow source revision; prior 916 overall future execution acceptance withdrawn.

findings.finding: Signal handler now only appends signal values. Main loop exclusively polls/reaps and forwards the first pending signal only after its poll returned None; 25-second escalation uses the same ownership condition.

No post-reap killpg remains. Finally signals only when its sole-owner poll says the leader is not reaped, and production descendant cleanup remains pidfd-based with verified named-cgroup membership under the global resource lock.
Actual tiny-child regression forbids any killpg after child completion; a real reap plus injected SIGINT verifies no handler poll reentry or stale group signal.
